title: Pergola Configurator
blurb: Production 3D configurator on a live Shopify storefront, also embedded into Wix and Webflow via cross-origin postMessage. Physics, generated PDF quotes, and the whole configuration compressed into a shareable URL.

title: Bath Configurator
blurb: Bathroom configurator with fixtures, finishes, lighting and AR. Carries the compression work I cite everywhere else: 32.8 MB down to 6.75 MB with WebP textures and Draco geometry. I also run its hosting: droplet, Spaces CDN, DNS, nginx.

title: Modular House Configurator
blurb: Exterior and interior configurator for a modular-house manufacturer with 1,400+ houses built, with AR placement at real-world scale — put the house in your garden through a phone camera.

title: Camper Trailer Configurator
blurb: Finishes and fittings for a steel camper, with a QR hand-off from desktop to phone for AR. Nice material work — sheen and transmission on the glazing.

title: TRON Energy Rental — Mini App
blurb: Telegram Mini App that lowers TRON transaction fees by renting energy: accounts, multi-wallet management, hourly rent, order packages, top-ups and QR payment codes, in six languages. Still live.

title: TRON Energy Rental — Admin
blurb: The operator side of the same service: client management, rent orders, e-cash top-ups, referrals and mailing. The most modern stack I have shipped.

title: Laptop Parts Storefront
blurb: Server-rendered e-commerce: catalogue, filters, product pages, basket, checkout, favourites and warranty flows, on a Strapi backend.

title: Appliance Storefront
blurb: Multilingual storefront with Nova Poshta delivery integration, product comments and a filtered catalogue, built on RTK Query.

title: Sports Community App
blurb: Posts, likes, replies and charts over a Strapi backend, with the user flow designed alongside the build.

title: Investment Firm Site
blurb: Marketing site for a financial services firm: department pages, video modals, sliders and progress meters, built to a Figma spec.
